statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The service billed is CPT code 93247
The service is a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study
The diagnosis codes submitted are I48.91, I48.0, and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial reason is that the procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is medically necessary to characterize rhythm disturbances and correlate them with the patient's syncope
